chapter: Style, peers and the 1963 New Orleans scene
title: Trumpeters Sharpie and Tony Almerico
summary: They comment on trumpeter Sharpie Jones's felt derby and on Tony Almerico, who died of cancer the previous year.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: That's what Sharpie used, don't it? Old felt, don't it?
Yeah. Yeah. All the time. Yeah. Mm-hmm.
With a red fella. Yeah, old Sharpie. Nice trumpet player, man.
I like Sharpie. That's a good one, man.
He used to blow like a song. Quote Tony Amarica, had another trumpet player around here. Bob Lord of Metty. Oh, yeah. Tony Amarica, he died last year.
Nice trumpet player. Yeah, I heard he died. Pass. Yeah, very nice, though. He died with cancer. Mm-hmm. Sure enough. Prostrate, I imagine.
